parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from Page 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of data that is collected by Log Service. Valid values:

*   file: the file type
*   stdout: the standard output type

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas query-sls-log-store-list --app-id af58edcf-f7eb-0000-0000-db4e425f0000 --type file --page-size 1000 --current-page 1 --region cn-hangzhou
